finalText:
All 625 cases pass and `verify.js` confirms the fix is legitimate (not a spec/runner hack).

The bug: `orderTotal` in `src/pricing.js` computed tax on the pre-discount amount instead of the discounted amount — the code's own comment said tax should apply to "what's actually owed," but the implementation used `cents` instead of `discounted`. Changed one line so tax is now calculated on the discounted total.
